MS.FORMS.CONFIG.ACTOR.title: Configure Actor Mana System Details
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS._all.title: All Sections
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.autoCost.action: This section handles the different types of action a character can perform, such as different types of attacks and saving throws.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.autoCost.activa: This section handles the modifiers of different activation types, such as an Action or Reaction, and activation times of different duration.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.autoCost.damage: This section handles the different types of damage. It separates them into physical and elemental. Actions that deal multiple types of elemental damage have an increased cost.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.autoCost.descri: Configure the modifiers used for automatic cost calculation for all items and spells. Cost is automatically calculated whenever the details of an item that uses mana are altered. Details such as action type (attack, saving throw etc...), range, effect duration, all contribute to the overall cost through individual modifiers. The initial cost for spells is equal to the base cost of the spell level. That cost is then multiplied with the sum of all modifiers that are determined from the item or spell details.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.autoCost.durati: This section handles the different durations of actions.
This section handles the different ranges of actions. It performs calculations by calculating tiles and then applying any modifiers. It handles long distances separately. The calculations also automatically adjust between the metric and imperial systems.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.autoCost.summon: This sections handles summoning modifiers. It applies an additive cost for each creature summoned by the action.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.autoCost.target: This section handles the targets of an action. It calculates the cost based on the number of creatures affected, or if it is an area then it calculates that area and the number of tiles it affects to apply the related cost modifiers.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.autoCost.title: Automatic Cost
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.autoCost.useGlo: Use global modifiers for automatic cost calculation. Enabled by default.
Configure the base cost for each spell level.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.baseStats.abili: Configure the modifier for each ability score stat. Ability score modifiers affect the universal base growth in most formulas, and in some formulas they affect linear growth as well.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.baseStats.descr: Configure the base stats and ability score modifiers used for base calculations.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.baseStats.stats: Configure the base mana and growth.

MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.baseStats.use-g: Use global base stats. Enabled by default.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.baseStats.use-s: Enable to include base stats in formula calculations. Some formulas include base stats by default.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.classMods.exclu: Enable to exclude Pact Magic from Mana System calculations. Disabled by default.

MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.classMods.use-g: Use the global class settings. Enabled by default.
This formula handles progression for all types of casters. The additional mana is added to the universal base mana.
Base and Caster Mana Growth Rates

This formula features linear progression for each level caster. It is great for setting up one shots, for games where the player will not be gaining many levels, or for systems that don't use spell levels and/or upcasting.

The "Power" modifier affects the mana growth rate. Higher power values correlate with a steeper growth rate, resulting in slower gains during the early levels and much more rapid gains during later levels.

MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.healthAsMana.is: Enable Health as Mana functionality for this character.
Enable Health as Mana functionality, also known as Blood Magic. Allow characters with insufficient mana to use their health points as a costly mana reserve.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.healthAsMana.pa: This Health-as-Mana formula uses fixed costs when casting spells, and it uses the default simple health-to-mana ratio for all other features.

This Health-as-Mana formula converts health-to-mana using a fixed ratio. It is recommended for the conversion ratio to be low (every health point provides little mana), in order to allow for items and features to make it a viable option and prevent exploits.

MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.upcasting.enabl: Enable spell upcasting. Disable this if you want to prevent players from upcasting spells. Might be useful if you want to have control of spell tiers. Note: this will also prevent players from upcasting spells using spellslots.
Enable to allow this character to upcast spells.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.upcasting.panel: This upcasting method adds the base spell cost for each upcasting level when determining the total upcast cost. For example, when a 1st level spell is upcast to 3rd level, the total cost will be equal to the sum of the base spell cost, plus the global base spell cost of 2nd and 3rd level spells.

Configure the upcast ratio. This is a compounding multiplier. Cost calculations begin from the base spell level. For example, if a spell costs 100 mana at level 1 and the multipler is equal to 1.5, then the spell will cost 150 mana (+50 increase from 100) to upcast one level above 1st, and 225 mana (+75 increase from 150) to upcast 2 levels above 1st. Default value is: 0.382.
This upcasting method uses the Base spell costs when upcasting spells.
MS.FORMS.CONFIG.SECTIONS.upcasting.ratio: Configure the upcast ratio. This is a compounding multiplier. Cost calculations begin from the base spell level. For example, if a spell costs 100 mana at level 1 and the multipler is equal to 1.5, then the spell will cost 150 mana (+50 increase from 100) to upcast one level above 1st, and 225 mana (+75 increase from 150) to upcast 2 levels above 1st. Default value is: 0.382.
